newsitem.title: UK: MAS drops ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: MAS drops ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd dropped its ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge with effect from Wednesday (April 16), its UK cargo manager Shahid Mir told Reuters.
The surcharge, of six UK pence per kg, was implemented last November in line with the policies of many other carriers to counter rising fuel costs.
"The price of fuel has now returned to a respectable level and so I see no reason to continue with the surcharge," said Mir.
He stressed that his decision, which had received full backing from MAS' Kuala Lumpur head office, was applicable only to ex-UK services.
"The surcharge was also imposed in (Continental) Europe but I cannot speak for the managers responsible there," he added.
